entry.title: Make Chrome #enable-experimental-web-platform-features flag consistent
entry.content:
Summary

Make Chrome flags the same everywhere using the following format. It based on what is already in BCD as a majority.

{
  "type": "preference",
  "name": "#enable-experimental-web-platform-features",
  "value_to_set": "Enabled"
}

entry.title: Updates for Chrome 155 beta
entry.content:
The https://collector.openwebdocs.org/ project (v10.20.11) found new features shipping in Chromium 155 beta which was released this week. Currently, the collector covers about 90% of BCD, so the following list might not be exhaustive. Also, if a feature is in Canary/behind flags, it is not considered here. If a feature is missing, one reason can be that the IDL is not yet in a specification or in webref.

Chrome 155 stable releases on October 6, 2026. This PR needs to be merged before/with the BCD release on October 1, 2026.

With this PR, BCD will consider the following features as shipping in Chromium 155:

Modern Crypto algos, https://chromestatus.com/feature/5198951632470016

  • api.SubtleCrypto.decapsulateBits
  • api.SubtleCrypto.decapsulateKey
  • api.SubtleCrypto.encapsulateBits
  • api.SubtleCrypto.encapsulateKey
  • api.SubtleCrypto.getPublicKey
  • api.SubtleCrypto.supports_static

CSS symbols(), https://chromestatus.com/feature/5146996093616128

  • css.properties.list-style-type.symbols
  • css.properties.list-style.symbols

CSS margin-trim, https://chromestatus.com/feature/5197863732772864

  • css.properties.margin-trim
  • css.properties.margin-trim.block
  • css.properties.margin-trim.block-end
  • css.properties.margin-trim.block-start
  • css.properties.margin-trim.none

CSS text-decoration-skip-spaces, https://chromestatus.com/feature/4832783806627840

  • css.properties.text-decoration-skip-spaces
  • css.properties.text-decoration-skip-spaces.all
  • css.properties.text-decoration-skip-spaces.end
  • css.properties.text-decoration-skip-spaces.none
  • css.properties.text-decoration-skip-spaces.start

These two features are not tested by the Collector, I mark them as shipping in a separate commit.

  • JPEG XL, https://chromestatus.com/feature/5114042131808256
  • import text modules, https://chromestatus.com/feature/5191512456560640

From what I can tell in the current 155 beta, these features are not included:

  • HTML streaming methods, https://chromestatus.com/feature/5054329641893888
  • WebTransport responseHeaders, https://chromestatus.com/feature/5194104408506368
  • Window controls, https://chromestatus.com/feature/5201832664629248

See also https://developer.chrome.com/blog/chrome-155-beta and https://chromestatus.com/roadmap

entry.title: Remove partial_implementation from ariaNotify() for Chromium
entry.content:
Summary

Per discussion in #29610, the unreliable announcement behaviour on macOS is a VoiceOver/OS limitation rather than a browser difference.

I'm therefore removing the partial_implementation flag for Chromium, and rewriting the notes for clarity.

Test results and supporting details

This was tested by @janewman, who found nearly identical behaviour in Chromium and Firefox, and discussed with @caugner and @ddbeck.

Related issues

Fixes #29610.
